protocol.study: Regenerative nominal Sakhir PPO actor-width comparison
protocol.primary_endpoint: Final deterministic fine-grid policy from every training seed; no best-checkpoint selection
protocol.secondary_endpoint: Final stochastic training/fine/refined paired evaluations with five fixed action-noise seeds; summarize within training seed first
protocol.aggregation: Mean, sample standard deviation and range across three training seeds; no significance or convergence claim from this sample alone
protocol.conditions: Same 55 decisions/lap, 8 observations, automatic MGU-K recovery, 2 MJ initial/0.1 MJ reserve and 70 m/s start/finish as regeneration pilot; no final-test telemetry
protocol.rng_isolation: Every evaluation restores Python, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA RNG states; each coarse/fine stochastic member starts from the same evaluation seed
protocol.schedule: Constant learning rate and clip range; training state persists across4096-step learn calls; separate evaluation environments
protocol.gate: All final deterministic and stochastic replays feasible; training-to-fine gain-versus-zero discrepancy <=0.05 s; additional fine-to-refined paired advantage, lap-time and battery/recovery convergence gates apply to all final pairs
protocol.failure_policy: Preserve all failed gates and seeds; aggregate completed seeds without filtering numerical failures. An accepted study requires all three complete and all final replay/refinement gates pass. Do not relax thresholds after observing results.
protocol.interpretation: Primary endpoint remains final deterministic 8800-cell lap. The 17600-cell replay diagnoses paired numerical uncertainty. Passing a numerical gate is not evidence of statistical significance; three seeds provide descriptive variation only.

width_comparison.estimand: Final nominal deterministic primary-grid time difference, width 32 minus width 64 for each matched seed, at the same 16384-step budget. Report all seeds, signs, mean, range and feasibility. Same critic architecture; independent initialization at each actor width. Historical small runs are verified controls.
width_comparison.checks: All deterministic width gaps on 160 and 320 cells per block, maximum absolute change 5 ms per seed. Report failed pairs; prioritize finish feasibility before speed. Original nominal full-request and stochastic refinement gates remain in force. Transfer is descriptive on two predeclared conditions, no retuning. No width sweep or pruning.
